findings.rationale: Client-level screen flags min_norm_ratio z=-7.9 (min 0.0035, the most extreme of the federation). Per-round updates show exact-zero update norms in rounds 9, 12 and 15 (the upload is the global model returned unchanged), and near-zero norms in rounds 2 (0.053) and 4 (0.102) and 5 (0.020), while the other rounds train normally (norm ratio ~1). This pattern is what free-riding looks like, not sign-flip or scaling poisoning. Earliest faulty round is 2.

Client-level screen flags min_norm_ratio z=-5.4 (min 0.0022). Per-round updates show exact-zero norms in rounds 5, 9, 12 and 15, near-zero norms in rounds 2 (0.0062) and 4 (0.072), and normal training (norm ratio ~1.0-1.3) in the other rounds. Same free-rider signature as WI. Earliest faulty round is 2.

Client-level screen flags min_norm_ratio z=-5.9 (min 0.0017). Per-round updates show exact-zero norms in rounds 5, 9 and 12, near-zero norms in rounds 2 (0.074), 4 (0.119) and 15 (0.046), and normal training in the remaining rounds. Same free-rider signature as WI and IN. Earliest faulty round is 2.

report.summary: Screened all 52 clients with the all-client views of client_updates, client_performance, drift_by_round, feature_summary and subgroup_outcomes (Sex, AgeGroup, Income). Three clients (WI, IN, NE) show a consistent free-rider signature: exact-zero or near-zero update norms in several rounds while training normally in others, with min_norm_ratio flagged at z between -5.4 and -7.9 and confirmed per round. They are reported as free_rider with onset round 2. Other weaker leads were not reported as faults because each rests on a single noisy statistic that does not reach the confirmation threshold: CT (AgeGroup 1 outcome rate 1.0 with predicted 0, z_noise 5.3, while its client performance is normal), GU (small client with a Stroke sd outlier, a Sex-subgroup O/E outlier and CITL z -3.3), VI (Sex-subgroup FNR outlier and low AUC on a small client), and NH (Income-2 outcome-rate outlier, z_noise 3.3). Client performance, drift and feature screens found no other flagged clients. The budget was exhausted (20.0 spent), so the leads above could not be confirmed with narrower queries.
